proofConditions.description: Every sample loaded the requested versions, reached identical final data, and passed every invariant.
One subscriber is a negative control: every arm has one query commit plus one derived-state commit.
proofConditions.evidence: 8 samples per arm at one subscriber

proofConditions.description: Every arm preserves one logical Apollo notification per query subscriber.
proofConditions.evidence: logical notify count equals subscriber count in every sample

proofConditions.description: The scoped 3.14.1 patch preserves all observer deliveries while draining them in one shared task.
proofConditions.evidence: the patched arm retains N Apollo notification tasks and adds one shared delivery task

proofConditions.description: The shared delivery task neither drops nor deduplicates subscriber values.
proofConditions.evidence: queued = delivered = subscriber count, in one batch, for every patched sample

proofConditions.description: Every timer, React-facing observer delivery, microtask checkpoint, and commit followed the source-derived task timeline.
proofConditions.evidence: observer delivery ran after its timer callback with no active browser event in every sample

proofConditions.description: Stock 3.6.9 uses one query commit and one derived-state commit.
Stock 3.14.1 repeats both the query and derived-state commits for each subscriber.
The scoped 3.14.1 observer-delivery patch restores the two-commit result.
Fragmented query commits cause real repeated React component rendering in the derived parent tree.
proofConditions.evidence: stock 3.14.1 renders N(N+1) subscriber subtrees; 3.6.9 and patched 3.14.1 render 2N
